package samples.realizationclient

import framework.dsl.*
import framework.dsl.Finite.given
import framework.realize.*
import samples.{
  Bank,
  Kettle,
  ReliableBroadcast,
  TwoLayeredCache,
  TwoPhaseCommit,
  Voting
}
import scala.compiletime.testing.typeChecks

object SampleRealizations:
  enum Addr:
    case holder, receiver

  enum Acceptor:
    case first, second, third

  enum Value:
    case first, second

  enum Manager:
    case first, second, third

  val bank = new Bank.Model[Addr](Addr.holder, 2)
  val voting = new Voting.Model[Acceptor, Value](
    Value.values.toSet,
    Set(
      Set(Acceptor.first, Acceptor.second),
      Set(Acceptor.first, Acceptor.third),
      Set(Acceptor.second, Acceptor.third)
    )
  )
  val commit = new TwoPhaseCommit.Model[Manager](Manager.values.toSet)

  def realize(machine: Machine[?, ?]): Realization =
    Realization(
      name = "sample",
      machine = machine,
      producer = "sample-client",
      producerVersion = "1",
      roles = Vector.empty,
      correlation = Correlation("", "", "", "", 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1),
      scripts = Vector.empty
    )

  def main(args: Array[String]): Unit =
    val _ = args
    val machines = Vector[Machine[?, ?]](
      bank,
      voting,
      commit,
      Kettle.Model,
      ReliableBroadcast.Model,
      TwoLayeredCache.Model
    )
    val roots = machines.map(realize)
    assert(roots.size == 6)
    roots
      .zip(machines)
      .foreach: (root, machine) =>
        assert(root.machine eq machine)
        assert(root.nativePerformances.isEmpty)
    assert(typeChecks("realize(bank)"))
    assert(!typeChecks("realize(classOf[Bank.Model[Addr]])"))
    assert(
      !typeChecks(
        "realize((holder: Addr, supply: Int) => new Bank.Model[Addr](holder, supply))"
      )
    )
